tasks.gr7-personal-social-wellbeing-t3: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering diversity, human rights, gender stereotypes, career awareness, and social change. Ask learners to identify inclusive actions, link rights to responsibilities, and connect strengths to future pathways.
tasks.gr7-physical-education-t3: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering athletics, indigenous games, flexibility, endurance, and teamwork. Ask learners to identify safe technique, pacing choices, progress tracking, and fair-play leadership in movement tasks.
tasks.gr7-creative-arts-t3: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering South African heritage, mixed media, scene building, choreography, and evaluation. Ask learners to recognise respectful cultural representation, process evidence, and polished performance choices.
